errors.text_span: Всички сектори са ясно маркирани с етикети и проценти вътре в тях, с изключение на двата най-малки, които не са етикетирани с числови стойности.
errors.evidence: This sentence is factually incorrect and self-contradictory. Firstly, no sectors have text labels inside them; the labels are in the legend. Secondly, it incorrectly claims that all sectors are marked with percentages, before immediately contradicting itself. Only four of the six sectors have percentage values displayed within them.
